p=Path('data/lexicon_builder/2026-11-12/ssl-explicit-genera/ssl-api-checkpoint/teaching.db')
rows=[]
with GSEEncoder(db_path=p) as enc:
 enc.conn.execute('PRAGMA query_only=ON')
 for text,lemma in cases:

  v={'text':text,'lemma':lemma,'pos':t.pos,'primitives':t.word_primitives,'status':t.lexical_evidence['selection_status'],'selected':(t.lexical_evidence.get('selected_record')or{}).get('entry_id'),'proof':t.lexical_evidence.get('contextual_grounding')}
  rows.append(v); print(json.dumps({k:v[k] for k in ['text','pos','primitives','status','selected']}))
Path('docs/readings/2026-11-13-ssl-explicit-genera/ssl-api-runtime-primary-frame-development.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'DEVELOPMENT_NOT_FINAL','records':rows},indent=2)+'\n')
